source_context: Sandbox historical replay evidence pilot for Singapore transport engineering manufacturing movements.
evidence_items: Singapore transport engineering output in 2021 was affected by aviation recovery and changing aerospace demand as travel activity gradually resumed.
Aircraft maintenance and aircraft repair activity supported parts of the transport engineering sector as fleet maintenance requirements returned.
Marine engineering and ship repair activity reflected offshore engineering conditions and recovery in regional industrial activity.
MRO demand, travel recovery, and fleet maintenance shaped the transport engineering production cycle during the year.
